Hi Aiden / Lara —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. As discussed, we’d love to run a short series of co-marketing activities to introduce QuantumBridge Consulting to our mid-market customers and developer community. Initial ideas: a 1-hour webinar (technical demo + customer panel), a half-day field partner roundtable in SF, and a follow-up joint blog + customer quote swap.

Goals (quick):
- Generate 80–120 Sales Qualified leads across both events
- Position QB as a recommended consultancy for Redwood Private deployments
- Surface 2 customer stories for joint case studies

Questions for you:
1) Do you have two customers who can speak to implementation outcomes?
2) What marketing support / MDF should we plan for?
3) Any hard date constraints (Aug–Sep windows)?

Attached: RB_QuantumBridge_OneSheet.pdf and RB_Draft_Agenda_Guide.docx (very rough).

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30m planning call this week to lock dates and format
- Agree roles (presenters/moderator/producer) and promotional assets

Thanks — looking forward to teaming up.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0142

- MDF: we’d request $8k for production + paid social amplification; QB can cover travel for the customer panelists.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a short slide template and a 1-pager we can co-brand? I saw the one-sheet you attached — that will help.

Subject: Internal: QuantumBridge partner plan — budget + format recs

Dylan / team — seeing Aiden's MDF ask ($8k). A few internal notes so we’re aligned before the planning call:

- MDF: $8k is reasonable for production + paid social; recommend splitting 60/40 Redwood/QB for this program to preserve co-investment. Marketing ops can cover registration/workflow; request Ben to confirm trackable landing page capacity.
- Format recs: two options to test —
  1) Technical deep-dive (45 min demo + 15 min live AMA) — emphasize integration patterns, KV cache/latency tuning for Private deployments. Good for developer and infra audience.
  2) Customer panel (60 min) — 2 customers + 1 QB consultant + 1 Redwood product lead. Better for mid-market buyers and GTM.
- Field roundtable: target ~20 attendees (customers + prospects) at SF office or rented venue. Keep vendor table small, focus on roundtable + short live demos.

Action items before call:
- Ben: confirm landing page and budget tracking capacity
- Marissa: draft outreach sequence and promotional timeline
- Dylan: get customer names from Aiden + confirm venue window
